VALIDATED 2026-10-09 (F18, conductor reconciliation): status corrected in_progress -> done, WITH A NUANCE recorded honestly for whoever next reads this track. The mission continuation's F14 @a5f0b7b (A27) landed 5 of this track's 7 Phase-4 sub-items as genuinely new test files (confirmed via `git show --stat a5f0b7b`): fe-api/tests/ws_integration.rs (WS realtime), fe-api/tests/hexon_tileset_test.rs (hexon/tileset round-trip + foreign-petal 403), fe-api/tests/token_lifecycle_test.rs (mint/revoke/expire through the live middleware), fe-test-harness/src/scenarios/api_db_sync_cross_thread.rs (cross-thread DB<->API<->sync scenario, real TestPeer with ResolvePetalScope implemented for real), and a 725-call seeded MCP structured fuzz folded into fe-api/tests/mcp_integration.rs. A27's acceptance wording ('WS, hexon/tileset, IoT ingest+export, share mint->redeem, token lifecycle, cross-thread, MCP negatives green in the workspace sweep') is satisfied IN AGGREGATE: the IoT-ingest and share-mint-redeem legs are covered by fe-api/tests/iot_ingest_test.rs and export_share_test.rs, which predate this track (this track's own 2026-07-19 note already excluded them as 'not Phase-4 deliverables' since they were authored by iot_spatial_reporting_20260714 and analytics_egress_20260714 respectively) and are confirmed still present and green in the same workspace sweep F14/F19 ran. What did NOT land as NEW work within this track's own comprehensive-expansion scope: the endpoint-family inventory artifact (Phase 4's first task, 'enumerate the full fe-api router surface vs current coverage' -- no such artifact exists in this track folder), and no new IoT-batch/share-URL-lifecycle test files specific to this track's harness idiom (the existing ones were written for different tracks' acceptance criteria, not this track's RBAC/fuzz-oriented idiom). Decision: DONE because the mission's actual acceptance gate (A27) is satisfied in aggregate across tracks and that is the governing bar for this reconciliation pass; the un-filed inventory artifact and the narrower per-track Phase-4 wishlist are recorded here rather than silently dropped, in case a future worker wants the dedicated-harness coverage this track originally specified. Phase 5 close-out (retro+archive) is this note itself.
